Current named shrine POI 52776572251048, courtyard/gallery 52776572301940, tomb 35185528314643 and Qibla Gate 17601319459877 support this identity. Main gallery 52776572301940 surrounds the exact central four-vertex core 35185434669244. Dome 35185101411085 and paired balcony/upper-minaret controls fix their own centers. Ten mapped gate roofs and small 14.5 m roof caps are retained individually. Heading -0.22117434116265272 radians aligns the front core edge with positive X east-southeast; positive Z south-southwest faces the minarets and principal portico. Current ring is mapped as roofed, and the supplementary courtyard photograph shows rooflights: the model follows that covered footprint, not the earlier open-court photograph. Facade facing and internal bays are picture-led approximations. External western expansion, crypts, tomb furniture, streets and surrounding city remain host content or omitted.
